mapper.update: UPDATE inspect_plan_project SET inspected_count = #{inspectedCount} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE inspect_plan_project pp SET pp.total_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station s WHERE s.project_id = pp.project_id AND s.deleted = 0), pp.inspected_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspect_record r WHERE r.plan_project_id = pp.id) WHERE pp.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspect_plan_project pp INNER JOIN inspect_plan p ON p.id = pp.plan_id WHERE pp.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status IN (0, 1)
